info.title: Info & Support
info.subtitle: FAQ, version & contact
info.aboutBody: Compass — Your Creative Compass is a weekly idea planner, reminder and AI assistant for niche content creators. All data is stored on your device.
info.faq1q: Where do the ideas come from?
info.faq1a: From two sources: 1) A pre-built pool of 270+ ideas for 9 niches, 2) Instant niche-specific generation via AI mode.
info.faq2q: Do I need to give an API key to the AI?
info.faq2a: No, not required. You can use the pool mode only. If you want, the example proxy in the backend-example folder works with your own key.
info.faq3a: Yes, on first launch all content is stored on your device (AsyncStorage). Idea generation, streak tracking, idea bank, planning & calendar, all saved niches work. Only AI idea generation and Q&A Assistant require internet. When offline the app works normally, only AI features fall back to the smart pool.
info.faq4a: Check the notification permission in system settings. Reminders also arrive when the app is closed.
info.faq5a: In AsyncStorage on your phone. No internet sharing. You can reset anytime from Settings.
info.faq6q: Can I add a new niche?
info.faq6a: Currently 9 niches are supported. You can add new ideas to data/content-pool.json.
info.faq7a: When you open the home page, today is recorded. Your streak increases by consecutive days.

qa.title: 💡 Inspiration Board
qa.subtitle: Today's inspiration · idea search · quick tips
qa.emptySub: Ask about content creation, niche strategy or hook design.
qa.offlineMsg: Q&A doesn't work offline right now. Check your internet connection.
qa.tipFitnessTxt: A 1-sentence post answering "what did you do?" after a workout gets the highest engagement.
qa.tipFoodTxt: In recipes show the photo first, then ingredients. Hunger triggers the click.
qa.tipTechTxt: The "X vs Y?" format doubles comments. Stay neutral, let the viewer decide.
qa.tipTravelTxt: Post a summary of your destination's "cost, days, food" — the guide format sticks.
qa.tipGamingTxt: Use the most exciting 5 seconds of the video as the first frame. Viewers stay past 5 seconds.
qa.tipPersonalDevTxt: The "3 books / 3 habits / 3 lessons" trio gets shared 3x more than book summaries.
qa.tipBeautyTxt: A 5-second before/after gets 4x more saves than a product review.
qa.emptyBank: Your idea bank is empty. Generate with "Smart Refresh" on the home page, then search here.
qa.emptyNoMatch: No matching ideas found. Try a different keyword.
qa.q4: Inspiration doesn't come — you summon it.
qa.q5: You don't have to be perfect to share — being real is enough.
qa.q8: Giving up is worse than never starting.
qa.q11: Your niche may be small; but its impact can be big.
qa.q12: Community stands with those who create value, not those who post often.
qa.tipFashionTxt: Show the same outfit in 3 different lights; viewers ask "which one can I also do?"
qa.m1: Today's step is the foundation of tomorrow's success.
qa.m3: Tell one idea from 7 angles, reach a new audience each time.
qa.m4: As long as your content creates value, time rewards you.
qa.m5: Asking a question is a stronger trick than answering.
qa.m6: 1 idea today is tomorrow's raw material for 10 contents.
qa.m7: Consistency grows you more than perfection does.
qa.m8: Your first 10 contents are teachers, not an audience.
qa.m9: Every post you publish becomes the reference for the next one.
qa.m10: The more curiosity a title sparks, the more clicks it earns.
qa.m11: Your own story is your most powerful raw material.
qa.m12: Reading comments is the fastest way to find new content ideas.
